fact: A June 2026 Addis Ababa workshop co-hosted by the Ethiopian Institute of Agricultural Research and the Agricultural Transformation Institute trained 50+ staff from seven countries including Ethiopia on the satellite-based CropWatch and ETWatch platforms for crop area, yield and evapotranspiration mapping, per AIRCAS.

FAO's EOSTAT project, with the Ethiopian Statistics Service, trained national experts in February 2025 in Adama and ran a pilot wheat yield study in Arsi Zone using DSSAT with Earth observation data and the GCVI vegetation index.
